title: Israel and Hamas Were Not Ready for a Comprehensive Peace Deal, Mediator Says

title: Texas Water Crisis Threatens Booming Industrial Hotspot for Exxon, Koch
summary: Water shortages in South Texas are posing major risks to a fast-growing industrial hub that’s crucial to President Donald Trump’s twin goals of dominating global energy markets and slashing trade deficits.

title: Zelenskiy, Trump in Second ‘Productive’ Call on Air Defense
